source_fix_candidates.title: Cached Contacts and editor admission survive a failed newer contact read
source_fix_candidates.observation: editable checks cached role/data/readOnly but not current query success/error; contact cards and an existing editor render from retained data. useContacts rethrows 403/503 without clearing retained success data. ContactEditor accepts readOnly from this stale projection.
source_fix_candidates.reproduction_to_run: Load editable contacts successfully; open a contact; cause exact contact query refresh to return403 or503; assert old cards/editor/action admission are removed and held continuation cannot dispatch. Then require successful explicit recovery before reopening; include actor/tenant/prospect replacement.
source_fix_candidates.not_claimed: No browser reproduction performed in this mapping; no native access or backend authorization bypass claimed.

source_fix_candidates.title: Existing-client link choices and confirmation outlive a failed current search
source_fix_candidates.observation: ClientLinkDialog renders query.data even when query.error is present; selected/confirmed survive search changes and failed current reads. Submit checks selected+confirmed+pending only, so current-read failure does not fence that UI intent.
source_fix_candidates.reproduction_to_run: Read matches successfully, select client and confirm; make a newer same-search read403/503 and hold recovery; verify stale choices/confirmation cannot dispatch convert. Successful current recovery must require current selection/confirmation, with no duplicate POST after an unknown result.
source_fix_candidates.not_claimed: No native conversion, billing or authorization bypass. Backend same-tenant/active/identity checks remain authoritative.

source_fix_candidates.title: Subordinate brief reads display retained success alongside newer failure
source_fix_candidates.observation: BriefHistory renders history.data versions, BriefRefresh renders proposal.data, and BriefViewer chooses historical.data without success/error gates. Current root brief uses current.isSuccess; this candidate concerns subordinate reads only.
source_fix_candidates.reproduction_to_run: Load version history/historical version/refresh comparison, then fail each exact read403/503; verify stale text/source selection and any edit path are withheld until deliberate successful recovery. Keep valid current brief and saved-version identity assertions.
source_fix_candidates.not_claimed: No runtime reproduction in this mapping; no new refresh-accept capability or native evidence claim.
